why: Tier-1 CI tooling (manager follow-up to CI-STREAMLINE-W45). REDUCES friction, adds no gate: operator-owed-guard and research-queue-dispatch-liveness grade repository state (row/receipt age), not the diff, so one stale row reddened every open PR. On a pull_request each now runs only when the diff touches its subject; on the scheduled backstop / push / merge_group / --all it always runs, so a stale row still reaches the manager. Self-tests stay unconditional. No required check is skipped for a code change.
